# Root substantive assent: runtime42/source439

Actual Claude Opus5 completed the independent source/formal review in Herdr wH:p6. I read the complete REVIEW.md, structured report and hash list. Subject SHA-256 78359b485ff648eb4c841769ca60e51ca69365c459f5ea1669f5995eb65361ad; review.json SHA-256 5c19cd30546bdc9017c76737bd79923e4ba40bec38a950f397d6e67a3cedb416. ACCEPT-DESIGN-UNIT with no required findings is appropriate for the exact three-path primitive. Activation must verify all original reviewer/source/formal pins and preserve reports unchanged.

The inner result separates terminal work/invalid-limit errors from ordinary pending read outcomes. Those outcomes stay private until the callback borrowing the same original reader finishes; successful bytes are released only after successful callback completion. The child cannot spend parent remainder, the original ledger is retained, postcheck errors have precedence, and caught nested failures/unwind prevent successful bytes. Independent33tests/workspace and eight ordering probe groups corroborate these behaviors, including callback panic. The actual File fixture supports usable original-file borrowing, not custody.

Qualifications: returning () does not mean the arbitrary callback has no channel to emit anything. It may mutate captured state or perform external effects; the API does not give it the newly accumulated Vec or pending result. The no-early-buffer-release property comes from private state and control flow plus the actual signature, not a general branded provisional-capability proof. No owned-observation unforgeability claim is adopted. Native owners may capture an after-observation into a local and consume it only if the helper succeeds. Likewise read_allowance is checked against the parent by with_allowance before the reader; the reviewer means there is no separate misuse category, not that it is unvalidated.

I continue to retain InvalidLimit failure closure and do not adopt the repeated optional proposal to weaken that boundary. A pure cost calculation before entry is a separate calculation, not permission to resume an active operation after a helper failure. Reserve allocation faults were not injected, so the eight probes do not establish every allocator behavior. EOF remains relative to the Read contract and reader/callback/drop internals remain outside qualification.

The review acknowledges the earlier root qualifications about returnable-split alternatives and limits of counting fixtures. Those original records remain intact. This approval covers439 only; private440 sizing and442 cache composition are not tested or approved here. Actual native read_one/ACL/descriptor/postcheck cost composition, actor/core/profile/custody/homebase/creator/P0/currentauthority and M2–M6 remain unfinished.
